text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D at gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each position by its prospects and my overall plan.","I tend to find losses especially painful and admitting a bad purchase difficult, so I should review losing positions objectively rather than hold them just to avoid realizing a loss.","I traded rarely during these periods, and that can be sensible: I should avoid reacting to month-to-month account swings and trade only when my reasons for holding or changing a position have changed."]}
